W6 after E057. Time ≈ 0.1 s fixed + steps × per-step cost. Per-step cost is pixel-proportional compute plus a bandwidth-bound part (BN/GELU/pointwise, ~27% of a 32 px step). Tip E049 reads 5.198 s and 0.7535 on seeds 0–2. E057's rebuild of the same commit read 5.223 s and 0.7536, so build noise is about ±0.05 s in time. The 3-seed accuracy mean moves about ±0.2–0.3 pp across rebuilds (E036 read 0.7532, 0.7525, 0.7497, 0.7544 and E050 0.7552 for one commit).

Mechanisms:
1. Accuracy rises slowly with optimizer steps, about 1–2.5 s/pp. Step, epoch and sample cuts trade near that dial (E020, E031, E040, E041, E045, E048).
2. Early low resolution is nearly free (E026, E033). The 32 px tail carries accuracy (E011, E018, E024).
3. Late backward truncation saves more than its MAC share, because a frozen block also skips BN/GELU backward, the optimizer update and Lookahead traffic (E028, E036, E046, E049, E053). Group 2 shows no cliff at 85% (E053).
4. Group 1 needs steady training and 32 px exposure. Losing it is a graded dose (E037 −0.45 pp, E054 −0.35, E055 about −0.15).
5. Averaging, LS, warm-up, Lookahead interval, BN recalibration and batch-split tweaks are null or negative. wd ×0.5 gave about +0.2 pp (E016). The recipe is near a local optimum.
6. Architecture surgery on high-resolution work (E051) loses more accuracy than it saves. Elementwise bytes are a real lever: E056 measured ReLU at about −0.25 s with accuracy about unchanged at 0.752.
7. Build noise and seed-set winner's curse (0.1–0.2 pp) dominate every decision under 0.15 pp. The population mean is about 0.752–0.754, so the bar is barely cleared.
8. My time forecasts for trim and freeze runs have been too high by 0.1–0.2 s. Widen the low side.

Unsure: the true rebuild SD, whether coarse labels are shipped and allowed, PCIe transfer, and whether the 3-seed gate can pass a faster recipe.

Prediction for these ideas: re-measuring existing commits gives times near their old values, with accuracy re-rolled by build noise.

Probably blocked, since the loader likely ships only fine labels; if run, the gain is uncertain.

cruxes: Is the ReLU swap (E056: 4.95 s, 0.752) a real time saving of about 0.25 s at no accuracy cost on fresh seeds, and can it stack with the freeze?
What is the rebuild SD of the 20-seed mean (H4.5.1)? That sets whether any sub-0.15 pp keep decision is meaningful and whether a faster recipe can pass the gate.
Does the judge's population mean on the PCIe build stay at or above 0.750, so the margin spent on cuts is safe?
